intent: In-memory SQLite result set: rows of typed SQValue cells plus a shared header/column-name list, with by-name row access and JSON serialize/deserialize.

objects.name: SQResultRow
objects.role: one row; cells addressable by index or by column name via a back-pointer to its owning SQResult

objects.name: SQResult
objects.role: the result set: headers + rows, iteration, JSON serialize/deserialize, legacy text/JSON serialize wrappers around SQResultFormatter

naming_quality.note: SQResultRow::result (owning-SQResult back-pointer) is a somewhat generic member name, though comments and the friendship make the relationship clear
